title: CNN screens eye-region phone photos for COVID-19 in a China-Spain multicentre study
summary: A convolutional neural network was trained on cellphone eye-region images (2436 pictures of 657 subjects, 155 infected) to classify COVID-19 cases. On a separate test set of 2138 pictures from 478 subjects (64 infected) it reached an image-level AUC of 0.913 (95% CI 0.898-0.927), sensitivity 0.695, specificity 0.904 and accuracy 0.875. Preprint with an industry funder; sensitivity is modest and metrics are per image.
ai_technology: Convolutional neural network binary classifier on eye-region images

evidence.tested: Image-level performance on a separate test dataset from China and Spain.
evidence.unknown: Subject-level performance and clinical deployment value; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A convolutional neural network classified COVID-19 status from eye images.
